name: Agent Blueprint
summary: Agent Blueprint helps companies decide, one agent at a time, whether an AI agent is worth it: set the number it has to hit before launch, measure its real cost and results at 90 days, and decide to keep, fix or stop it. $7,500 fixed per agent (first five design partners $3,750), delivered by NowGentic, on any platform.
